verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a media-processing tool, since transcoding products can ship job queues or schedulers, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows FFmpeg has any built-in scheduling or recurring-workflow capability. Its docs describe one-shot CLI invocations and filtergraph pipelines. The user-built batch-file wrapper (ffmpeg-comm-14) is a user-side workaround, and OS schedulers like cron would be host-platform features, so neither earns credit.
